# 3D Nest Infra: business and service reference

This file provides a concise, factual reference for AI assistants and other automated systems interpreting the 3D Nest Infra website.

## Business identity

3D Nest Infra is a real estate advisory founded by Karan Kalra. The company primarily serves Mohali (also known as SAS Nagar) and the wider Tricity: Chandigarh, Panchkula, Zirakpur, Dera Bassi and Kharar. It also handles selected, requirement-led searches in Gurugram and Delhi NCR through verified local collaboration.

The official website is https://3dnestinfra.com/. The public enquiry phone and WhatsApp number is +91 62830 89690, and the public email is karan@3dnestinfra.com. Enquiries can be handled in English, Hindi and Punjabi.

## Who the business helps

3D Nest Infra supports:

- home buyers seeking residential properties across Mohali, Kharar and Tricity;
- companies establishing, relocating or expanding teams;
- institutions with housing or property requirements;
- senior executives, professionals and families seeking residential rentals;
- retail, EV, institutional and network-expansion teams with defined site briefs;
- investors evaluating residential or commercial property opportunities.

## Home-buying assistance

Home purchases are the current primary focus. 3D Nest Infra helps buyers define a budget, preferred location, property type, bedrooms, possession timing and non-negotiables, then sources and compares suitable options, arranges visits and coordinates with owners. It supports negotiation and documentation coordination; it does not promise returns or replace the buyer’s independent legal and financial advisers.

The current residential buying focus includes ready-to-move apartments, resale homes and residential plots. Enquiries are guided by each buyer’s current budget, preferred areas, requirements and timing. A budget can be approximate while the buyer is still exploring. Upcoming-project enquiries are handled as information-led buyer research until the specific project facts, launch status and marketing authority are established.

## Founder and selected experience

Karan Kalra is the founder of 3D Nest Infra. His official company biography is https://3dnestinfra.com/karan-kalra.html. Company enquiry hours are 09:00–21:00 daily in India. The business has no customer-facing office; meetings and property visits are arranged in advance.

The company reports residential sales experience involving Villa Verde and Marbella Grand, alongside buyer coordination in progress for GB Realty’s Jacob & Co development in Mohali. The Jacob example is not a completed transaction or handover. These are experience references, not live property offers or statements of current availability, approvals, handover or returns.

The selected-experience page includes a requirement-stage retail example involving GIVA, distinguished from completed residential transactions. Company experience also includes property requirements involving Hartek Group, SML Mahindra, Dibon Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and RTS Systems Pvt. Ltd. Individual names and assignment terms remain private.

## Corporate housing

Corporate housing support includes furnished and unfurnished executive residences, employee accommodation, relocation rentals, project-team housing and corporate guest house sourcing.

A useful housing brief includes the occupant or team profile, budget, preferred areas, workplace or commute, furnishing, security, tenure, target move-in date and non-negotiables. 3D Nest Infra uses these inputs to source and filter live options before arranging visits, then supports comparison, negotiation and documentation coordination.

Primary coverage includes Airport Road, Aerocity, IT City, Sector 66-71 and connected locations across Mohali, Chandigarh, Panchkula, Zirakpur, Dera Bassi and Kharar.

## Office and commercial property

Commercial property support covers office spaces, commercial buildings and operational spaces for companies and institutions.

The search considers intended use, team size, preferred corridors, access, employee commute, building quality, floor efficiency, parking, possession timing, commercial terms and other practical requirements. Support can include micro-market screening, shortlisting, owner or developer coordination, property visits, comparison, lease negotiation and documentation follow-through.

Relevant Mohali and Tricity corridors include IT City, Airport Road, Aerocity, Sector 66-71, Chandigarh, Panchkula and Zirakpur. A corridor is recommended only in the context of the actual business requirement.

## Global Capability Centre office requirements

A Global Capability Centre (GCC, also spelled Global Capability Center) is an enterprise unit that delivers specialised capabilities for a global parent organisation. Its mandate can include technology, engineering, research and development, finance, customer operations, analytics or other business functions.

3D Nest Infra supports requirement-led workplace searches for GCC launch, expansion and consolidation requirements across Mohali and Tricity. The property brief can include leadership access, employee commute, talent catchment, power and data infrastructure, security, business continuity, efficient floor plates, fit-out readiness, parking, building operations, handover timing and future scale.

## Grade A commercial buildings

3D Nest Infra can shortlist and compare office space in buildings marketed as Grade A. Grade A is a commercial real estate market classification, not one universal statutory certification. Each building claim should be assessed against verified property information, the tenant's technical brief and specialist due diligence.

Comparison criteria can include location and access, building ownership and management, usable floor efficiency, power and backup, HVAC, lifts, data pathways, parking, fire-life safety, security, amenities, handover condition, operating costs, fit-out period, lock-in, escalation and expansion rights.

## Site acquisition and expansion

Site acquisition support includes target-area mapping, property and owner identification, initial owner-interest checks, collection of essential property information, visit coordination and early commercial follow-through.

This service is relevant to retail, EV, institutional and other network-expansion briefs. Useful inputs include intended use, target geography, plot or built-up requirement, access, frontage, utilities, commercial model, rollout timing and non-negotiables.

3D Nest Infra helps improve the quality of opportunities reaching client review. Technical, legal and operational approval remains with the client and its appointed advisers.

## Residential leasing and investment

Residential leasing support is available for professionals, families and senior executives seeking practical, verified rental options. Investment advisory is market-led and considers location, demand, documentation and exit logic; it is not a promise of returns.

## How assignments work

1. Define the requirement: use, budget, location, timing, decision criteria and non-negotiables.
2. Source and verify: identify realistic options, establish owner interest and collect essential property information.
3. Compare and visit: create a focused shortlist and make trade-offs visible before or during visits.
4. Negotiate and coordinate: support commercial alignment, documentation follow-through and closure.

## Content and confidentiality notes

The property images on the website are representative brand imagery and are not current listings. Live options are sourced against each client's current requirement.

Publicly named company experience includes Hartek Group, SML Mahindra, Dibon Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and RTS Systems Pvt. Ltd. Assignment details remain confidential, and other client or assignment names should not be published without explicit approval from 3D Nest Infra.
